source: the game's host/gen4_items.h (pret's decompilation of Pokémon Platinum, res/items)

items.name: Enigma Berry
items.doc: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it restores its HP if it is hit by a foe's supereffective attack.

items.name: Adamant Orb
items.doc: A brightly gleaming orb to be held by DIALGA. It boosts the power of Dragon- and Steel-type moves.

items.name: Babiri Berry
items.doc: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it weakens a foe's supereffective Steel-type attack.

items.name: Big Root
items.doc: A Pokémon hold item that boosts the power of HP-stealing moves to let the holder recover more HP.

items.name: Black Sludge
items.doc: A hold item that gradually restores the HP of Poison-type Pokémon. It inflicts damage on all other types.

items.name: Charti Berry
items.doc: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it weakens a foe's supereffective Rock-type attack.

items.name: Chilan Berry
items.doc: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it weakens a foe's Normal-type attack.

items.name: Choice Scarf
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This scarf boosts Speed, but allows the use of only one kind of move.

items.name: Choice Specs
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. These distinctive glasses boost Sp. Atk, but allow only one kind of move to be used.

items.name: Chople Berry
items.doc: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it weakens a foe's supereffective Fighting-type attack.

items.name: Coba Berry
items.doc: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it weakens a foe's supereffective Flying-type attack.

items.name: Colbur Berry
items.doc: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it weakens a foe's supereffective Dark-type attack.

items.name: Custap Berry
items.doc: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it gets to move first just once in a pinch.

items.name: Damp Rock
items.doc: A Pokémon hold item that extends the duration of the move Rain Dance used by the holder.

items.name: Destiny Knot
items.doc: A long, thin, bright red string to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder becomes infatuated, the foe does too.

items.name: Draco Plate
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Dragon-type moves.

items.name: Dread Plate
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Dark-type moves.

items.name: Dubious Disc
items.doc: A transparent device overflowing with dubious data. Its producer is unknown.

items.name: Earth Plate
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Ground-type moves.

items.name: Electirizer
items.doc: A box packed with a tremendous amount of electric energy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

items.name: Expert Belt
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a well-worn belt that slightly boosts the power of supereffective moves.

items.name: Fist Plate
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Fighting-type moves.

items.name: Flame Orb
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a bizarre orb that inflicts a burn on the holder in battle.

items.name: Flame Plate
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Fire-type moves.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If it has full HP, the holder will endure one potential KO attack, leaving 1 HP.

items.name: Full Incense
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that makes the holder bloated and slow moving.

items.name: Grip Claw
items.doc: A Pokémon hold item that extends the duration of multiturn attacks like Bind and Wrap.

items.name: Griseous Orb
items.doc: A glowing orb to be held by GIRATINA. It boosts the power of Dragon- and Ghost-type moves.

items.name: Haban Berry
items.doc: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it weakens a foe's supereffective Dragon-type attack.

items.name: Heat Rock
items.doc: A Pokémon hold item that extends the duration of the move Sunny Day used by the holder.

items.name: Icicle Plate
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Ice-type moves.

items.name: Icy Rock
items.doc: A Pokémon hold item that extends the duration of the move Hail used by the holder.

items.name: Insect Plate
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Bug-type moves.

items.name: Iron Ball
items.doc: A Pokémon hold item that cuts Speed. It makes Flying-type and levitating holders susceptible to Ground moves.

items.name: Iron Plate
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Steel-type moves.

items.name: Jaboca Berry
items.doc: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, and if a foe's physical attack lands, the foe also takes damage.

items.name: Kasib Berry
items.doc: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it weakens a foe's supereffective Ghost-type attack.

items.name: Kebia Berry
items.doc: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it weakens a foe's supereffective Poison-type attack.

items.name: Lagging Tail
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is tremendously heavy and makes the holder move slower than usual.

items.name: Life Orb
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the power of moves, but at the cost of some HP on each hit.

items.name: Light Clay
items.doc: A Pokémon hold item that extends the duration of barrier moves like Light Screen and Reflect used by the holder.

items.name: Luck Incense
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It doubles a battle's prize money if the holding Pokémon joins in.

items.name: Lustrous Orb
items.doc: A beautifully glowing orb to be held by PALKIA. It boosts the power of Dragon- and Water-type moves.

items.name: Magmarizer
items.doc: A box packed with a tremendous amount of magma energy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

items.name: Meadow Plate
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Grass-type moves.

items.name: Metronome
items.doc: A Pokémon hold item that boosts a move used consecutively. Its effect is reset if another move is used.

items.name: Micle Berry
items.doc: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it raises the accuracy of a move just once in a pinch.

items.name: Mind Plate
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Psychic-type moves.

items.name: Muscle Band
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a headband that slightly boosts the power of physical moves.

items.name: Occa Berry
items.doc: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it weakens a foe's supereffective Fire-type attack.

items.name: Odd Incense
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that boosts the power of Psychic-type moves.

items.name: Passho Berry
items.doc: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it weakens a foe's supereffective Water-type attack.

items.name: Payapa Berry
items.doc: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it weakens a foe's supereffective Psychic-type attack.

items.name: Power Anklet
items.doc: A Pokémon hold item that promotes Speed gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

items.name: Power Band
items.doc: A Pokémon hold item that promotes Sp. Def gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

items.name: Power Belt
items.doc: A Pokémon hold item that promotes Defense gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

items.name: Power Bracer
items.doc: A Pokémon hold item that promotes Attack gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

items.name: Power Herb
items.doc: A single-use item to be held by a Pokémon. It allows the immediate use of a move that charges on the first turn.

items.name: Power Lens
items.doc: A Pokémon hold item that promotes Sp. Atk gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

items.name: Power Weight
items.doc: A Pokémon hold item that promotes HP gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

items.name: Protector
items.doc: A protective item of some sort. It is extremely stiff and heavy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

items.name: Pure Incense
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It helps keep wild Pokémon away if the holder is the first one in the party.

items.name: Quick Powder
items.doc: An item to be held by DITTO. Extremely fine yet hard, this odd powder boosts the Speed stat.

items.name: Razor Claw
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a sharply hooked claw that ups the holder's critical-hit ratio.

items.name: Razor Fang
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It may cause the foe to flinch when the holder inflicts damage.

items.name: Reaper Cloth
items.doc: A cloth imbued with horrifyingly strong spiritual energy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

items.name: Rindo Berry
items.doc: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it weakens a foe's supereffective Grass-type attack.

items.name: Rock Incense
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that boosts the power of Rock-type moves.

items.name: Rose Incense
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that boosts the power of Grass-type moves.

items.name: Rowap Berry
items.doc: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, and if a foe's special attack lands, the foe also takes damage.

items.name: Shed Shell
items.doc: A tough, discarded carapace to be held by a Pokémon. It enables the holder to switch with a waiting Pokémon in battle.

items.name: Shuca Berry
items.doc: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it weakens a foe's supereffective Ground-type attack.

items.name: Sky Plate
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Flying-type moves.

items.name: Smooth Rock
items.doc: A Pokémon hold item that extends the duration of the move Sandstorm used by the holder.

items.name: Splash Plate
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Water-type moves.

items.name: Spooky Plate
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Ghost-type moves.

items.name: Sticky Barb
items.doc: A hold item that damages the holder on every turn. It may latch on to foes that touch the holder.

items.name: Stone Plate
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Rock-type moves.

items.name: Tanga Berry
items.doc: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it weakens a foe's supereffective Bug-type attack.

items.name: Toxic Orb
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a bizarre orb that badly poisons the holder in battle.

items.name: Toxic Plate
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Poison-type moves.

items.name: Wacan Berry
items.doc: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it weakens a foe's supereffective Electric-type attack.

items.name: Wave Incense
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that boosts the power of Water-type moves.

items.name: Wide Lens
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a magnifying lens that slightly boosts the accuracy of moves.

items.name: Wise Glasses
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a thick pair of glasses that slightly boosts the power of special moves.

items.name: Yache Berry
items.doc: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it weakens a foe's supereffective Ice-type attack.

items.name: Zap Plate
items.doc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Electric-type moves.

items.name: Zoom Lens
